lines: Curses: Hunter's Mark now counts the Marks you set (1.7% each, blank = full) and only raises hits; with a Hunter's Mark support on the skill too, only the bigger of the two counts.
War Banner: each Valour adds 0.5% more damage taken on top of its 6% (it used to raise the 6% by 0.5% a Valour).
Woe of Withering now raises your poison damage (its Poison line reached hits only). Woe of Sundering's Physical line now reaches bleeds too.
A Woe on a Guardian now says "x0.5 on a Guardian" next to its number.
Shock from your other skills: a skill whose Shocks stack (Living Storm) now counts all its stacks for your other skills, off Guardians. On a Guardian one shock counts, as before.

Cast on Crit with nothing linked is now cast by your main skill when it is an attack, else by your attack with the most damage on the bar. Any attack counts, Cyclone and other Movement attacks too, and a gem that is not on your bar no longer does.

EHP and Max hit: with a Guardian and its element picked in Configure Enemy, EHP is worked out against its crushing blow (two thirds physical, one third that element) instead of an even mix. The Max hit table gets a row for that blow.
Market: Copy mods copies the three mods worth the most to the character you have loaded (damage, and defence when Prioritize weighs it). With no character it copies the best-tier mods as before.

Item Simulator, Gear Set Sim and the tree optimizer: a Cast on Crit skill that counts by itself now adds its damage to your main skill instead of weighing as much as it. A small Cast on Crit spell no longer makes a much weaker weapon (a staff) come out on top.
New "Fortified stacks" box in Configure Enemy: type the stacks the game shows if you have more than your maximum Fortified lines give. 0 keeps the lines.

Spark skills strike again: since the 24 Nov game data, every Spark skill was simmed as one plain cast. Glacial Shards and Thunderfall get their spell lines back, Iaido Thrust its sheathe cut, Wind Vault its landing arrows, Lightning Arrow its return strike on a lone target, and Trap its re-arm time.
Unique lines follow the game's latest table (Cinderwick's strike rate is lower).
Channel Conduit: a channel that is not on your action bar no longer casts its linked spell; the spell uses its own supports.
A spell cast by a Channel Conduit now says so in its skill window, with a "Cast by hand" button. A support that cannot go into a skill says why.
Search box on every support picker (name or effect).
"Socket preset supports" for Heralds, Vows, Woes, Jarl's Roar, Sentences and movement skills; a new skill of these kinds gets them straight away.
"Packs and extras" and the other folded support groups stay open once you open them.
A new build starts at level 100, gem level 20 and all Dragonling points; lower them by hand.
New "Export for Oathfilter" button at the top of the Loot Filter tab and under your gear on the Character tab: copies a link with your worn gear for Oathfilter, demon_2m22's loot filter builder.
The sidebar now links to Oathfilter.
Energy Shield at the top of the page, in EHP and on the Advanced tab now counts your items' Base Grade and quality, their local % lines and "more" lines such as Vow of Warding. It read low before.
Evasion: the amount your level gives now matches the game (a little more below level 100).
Idol Sim and Gear Set Sim: a Vow on a red idol is never a +1 count line any more (+1 Ballista, Spark, Chain and the like). The game does not allow it, but the search put them there.
Idol Sim and Gear Set Sim: new box "Allow +1 count lines on idols", off by default. These Grand Idol lines are very rare drops, so the search leaves them out unless you tick it.
Save Creator: a copied build now gets the bonus passive points its tree needs. A full 128-point tree could come out with only 99 points in game.

Dragonling tree: the Dragon Ruptures box now follows the nodes you take. Taking a node past your points raises it (up to all 15) and refunding lowers it back, the way your level follows the passive tree's points. A crown is blocked only when it would not fit with all 15. (This went live with the last update.)
Recent Patch: the newest step is labelled Patch 91 + 92, because the public game data went from build 90 straight to 92. Its TLDR has "In short" lines that say which patch each change came with.
Recent Patch: game builds 89 and 90 are no longer listed twice.
Patch 91 and 92 rules that the game data did not carry by itself are now in the sim. They come from the developer's notes and rule files; none is checked in game yet, so tell us if one looks wrong.
Bina's Spotter's Helm: ramp up to 10% (patch 92, was 25%).
Ailment chance over 100%: each 1% over now gives 0.5% increased ailment damage (was 1%).

Kindled Remains: corpse bursts use the new shares (12.6% / 25.2% / 28.8% of corpse life by Rupture Level), grow with the skill's increased and more damage and with increased Corpse damage, and up to 3 corpses burst per hit. At high Rupture Levels it reads much lower than before.
Dual wielding: 25% more attack speed with a weapon in each hand (patch 92).
Hunter's Marks laid by minions count half: 0.85% each, 8.5% at 10 Marks (was 17%).
Minion mana: each kind of minion past the second makes every kind hold 25% more mana (patch 91).
Holy Elemental: your increased Holy damage lines now reach it.
Passive points: 5 more from Guardian kills at Rupture Level 105 to 145 (patch 91), so the most is 128 at level 100.
Best Rivenstone: gem level lines cost 4 Rivenstones (patch 92). One is picked only when you have that many, and it is weighed by its gain per stone.
Skill tree: Optimize tree, Plan tree and Plan next points work on a new plan once it has a skill (before, they did nothing), and say so when it has none.
Character tab: wear several Dwarven runes, one cell each, plus an empty cell to add another; the tree's Dwarven Sockets box follows how many you wear.

Many lines the sim used to leave out are now counted, as best guesses from their in-game text. Each one says so in the notes under the damage numbers; none is checked in game yet, so tell us if one looks wrong.

Lines with a condition now count: holding a Tome, wielding a Bow or Wand, unarmed (Facebreaker), skills that hit with both weapons, standing still (Anvil Stance, Hunter's Patience, The Last Square), and "below half life" lines with Scab of the Wound.

Dragonling nodes now counted: Mountain's Patience, Ancestral Echo, Sheathed Fury, Shaper of Flames, Deep Chill, Fault Lines, Jarl's Due, Thunderclap, Wound Echo, War Bringer, Culling Draw, Patient Host, March on the Sentenced.

Uniques now counted: The Reckoner's Wraps, Raijin's Fist and Moon-Leap Greaves (Fury), The Prismatic Codex, Mamushi Knuckles, Gravetithe, Jarlsbane, Mainspring Maul, The Mirror Oath, The Pilgrim's Pyre, Standard of the Last Legion, Gloomsilver Reliquary, Core-Splinter Idol.

Tree and minions: Hollow Crown (and The Keeper's Ember, Bone Choir Diadem), Covenant of Stone and Bone, Reaper's Due, Kindled Flesh, Storm Spotter, Wand Duelist, Standard of the Oath and Grave Standard (War Banner), Oathstone Ward, Sanctuary of Thought. Soul Rend on your bar now makes the enemy take 10% more from your minions.
Skill tree: lines the sim counts no longer show as "not counted", and defence or utility lines no longer show as not modelled.

Legion of One: a new "Legion of One kind" choice in Configure Enemy picks which of your summons stands. That kind gets the node's bonuses and your other summons count as 0 in every number (default: the strongest, as before).
Advanced tab: no longer goes blank when the main skill is a summon.
Character tab: a new Sim Idols button by the Fossil opens the Idol Sim in a window, so you can find and equip the best idols without leaving the tab.
